title: 13 Best Herbal Creams For Prostatitis
intro: Herbal creams for Prostatitis are topical preparations made from plant extracts, used to treat and relieve symptoms associated with prostatitis, an inflammation of the prostate gland. These creams have gained popularity due to their potential benefits, including reduced inflammation, improved circulation, and increased comfort, making them an attractive alternative to traditional treatments. Examples of herbal creams used to treat prostatitis include Saw Palmetto cream, which may help reduce the size of an enlarged prostate, and St. John's Wort cream, known for its anti-inflammatory properties; other examples include Ginseng cream, which may improve circulation and reduce pain, and Pygeum cream, derived from the bark of the African tree Prunus africana, which may also reduce prostate inflammation. Additionally, some creams may be formulated with a blend of herbs, such as Cnidium and Muira Puama, which are believed to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects that can help alleviate prostatitis symptoms.
